nodes.name: Evolution API Webhook
nodes.notes: Configure this URL in Evolution API as the webhook for MESSAGES_UPSERT events on your instance. Enable 'Webhook Base64' in Evolution API so media files arrive as base64 in the payload — no separate decrypt call needed.

nodes.name: Filter: Media Only
nodes.notes: Only forward messages that contain a downloadable file. Text/reaction/status events are dropped.

nodes.name: Filter: Groups Only
nodes.notes: Only process messages from group chats (remoteJid ends with @g.us). Individual DMs are ignored.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ groupId: $json.body.data.key.remoteJid, sender: $json.body.data.key.participant || $json.body.data.key.remoteJid, messageId: $json.body.data.key.id, fileName: $json.body.data.message?.documentMessage?.fileName || $json.body.data.message?.imageMessage?.caption || ($json.body.data.messageType + '_' + $json.body.data.key.id), fileBase64: $json.body.data.message?.documentMessage?.base64 || $json.body.data.message?.imageMessage?.base64 || $json.body.data.message?.audioMessage?.base64 || $json.body.data.message?.videoMessage?.base64 || $json.body.data.message?.stickerMessage?.base64 || $json.body.data.message?.pttMessage?.base64, mimeType: $json.body.data.message?.documentMessage?.mimetype || $json.body.data.message?.imageMessage?.mimetype || $json.body.data.message?.audioMessage?.mimetype || $json.body.data.message?.videoMessage?.mimetype || 'application/octet-stream' }) }}

nodes.name: POST to CRM Webhook
nodes.notes: Sends file as base64 to the CRM backend. Evolution API Webhook Base64 must be ON — base64 arrives directly in the payload, no separate decrypt call needed. Backend decodes → uploads to MinIO → inserts inbox_files row.

parameters.errorMessage: CRM webhook returned an error — check execution log

nodes.name: Log Error
nodes.notes: No retry loop — the CRM webhook is idempotent (dedup by messageId). If it fails, review logs.

notes: PREREQUISITE: In Evolution API → webhook settings, enable 'Webhook Base64' — this makes media arrive as base64 in the payload so no separate decrypt API call is needed.
Required env vars in n8n: none — URL and secret are hardcoded (update WEBHOOK_SECRET_HERE with your actual secret).
In Evolution API: set this workflow's webhook URL for event MESSAGES_UPSERT on your instance.
Webhook URL format: http://host.docker.internal:5678/webhook/hfs-receive-wa-file (if Evolution API runs in Docker on the same host as n8n).
Evolution API delivers ALL group messages from ALL monitored groups — the CRM resolves the right engagement by groupId.
Files from groups not linked to any engagement are stored in unmatched_inbox for manual review.
